    Lines of every length exclude contours #

    If the cover contains lines of every length, a contour of P (two different paths with the same nonzero value w) is impossible when B ≅ k(P) is minimal representation-infinite: the modules of the lines are indecomposable, pairwise of different dimensions, and killed by w (CLine.pdAct_contour_eq_zero), so B / (w) would be representation-infinite (BO13b, Lemma 7.2 (c), proof; noContour_of_lines).
